meta.note: Target look for PaNasMs (direction B · Home). Not yet implemented in PaNasMs/frontend.

tokens.name: wall
tokens.usage: Flat fallback under the theme background or the user wallpaper. Never put text or controls directly on it.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Main surface: cards, page header, taskbar, section navigation, widgets. Translucent in the two translucent themes.

tokens.name: panel-solid
tokens.usage: Always opaque surface: dialogs, sheets, menus, form fields, the knob of a switch. Use where text must stay readable over any wallpaper.

tokens.name: inset
tokens.usage: Recessed fill inside panel: default buttons, rows, key-value tiles, hover of navigation items.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers and progress tracks inside panel. Not for control borders.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of fields, checkboxes and quiet buttons, switch track when off. 3:1 on panel and panel-solid.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on panel, panel-solid and inset. Also the fill of the current item in section navigation, tooltips and toasts.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an ink fill.

tokens.name: mute
tokens.usage: Secondary text and idle icons on panel, panel-solid and inset.

tokens.name: disabled
tokens.usage: Text of disabled controls on inset. Exempt from the contrast minimum; never use for readable content.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one primary action of a view and the current section in the taskbar. Fill only, never text on panel.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent.

tokens.name: second
tokens.usage: Links, progress, selection outline, busy state, counters. Text on panel and panel-solid.

tokens.name: on-second
tokens.usage: Text on a second fill (taskbar counter).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring, 3px, on every interactive element.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Fill of a selected row, card or tree node, together with a second outline or check mark.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Healthy state: text on ok-bg, panel and panel-solid; switch track when on.

tokens.name: ok-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of a healthy tag or notice. Text: ok or ink.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Attention state: text on warn-bg, panel and panel-solid.

tokens.name: warn-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of an attention tag, notice, object card or the timed confirmation bar. Text: warn or ink.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error and destructive action: text on danger-bg, panel and panel-solid; fill of the destructive button and error toast.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a danger fill.

tokens.name: danger-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of an error tag, notice, invalid field or failed object card. Text: danger or ink.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: Overlay added to a button on hover.

tokens.name: press
tokens.usage: Overlay added to a button while pressed.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dimming layer behind dialogs and sheets.

tokens.name: veil
tokens.usage: Layer over a surface that waits for an operation.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Dialog title, name of the main object on a page.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Times use the NAS time zone.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Values, names and emphasis inside body text.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Secondary lines, hints, table headers, tags.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Group label in navigation and menus, upper case.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: The one big number of a widget.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between items of one control group (segmented, navigation list).

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons in a row; inner padding of navigation and menus.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between icon and label; between small tiles.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a column; phone side gutter; padding of inset tiles.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding; gap between page regions; desktop side gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Bottom page padding; padding of empty states.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, tooltips, menu items, small tiles.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inset rows and tiles, navigation items, notices, menus, toasts, multi-line fields.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, page header, section navigation, widgets, dialogs, tables.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, single-line fields, taskbar, switches, segmented controls.

tokens.name: shadow-chip
tokens.usage: Selected segment of a segmented control.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Menus, tooltips, toasts, selection bar.

tokens.name: shadow-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs and bottom sheets.

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Minimum height and hit area of every button, taskbar item and menu row.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Fields, section navigation items, page-level buttons.

tokens.name: rail
tokens.usage: Width of the section navigation rail; 264px when it lists objects.
